title: Rote 1.2.0 through 2.6.0 contains an authorization bypass in the OAuth bind/merge endpoint that allows authenticated…
description: Rote versions 1.2.0 through 2.6.0 have an authorization bypass vulnerability in the OAuth bind/merge endpoint. This flaw allows authenticated users to merge any OAuth-bound account into their own by submitting a public existingUserId along with a GitHub or Apple user ID. Exploitation enables attackers to take over victims' notes, attachments, API keys, and delete the victim's account.
